stem.en: A piston in a tube of air oscillates with a frequency of 20 Hz. How many oscillations does it make in one minute?

explanation.en: 20 Hz means 20 oscillations every second. One minute is 60 s, so 20 × 60 = 1200 oscillations.

hints.en: How many oscillations happen in one second at 20 Hz?
How many seconds are there in one minute?
